title: Data Analyst
description:
About Titan

Despite decades of innovation in money, the most important consumer money domain remains largely untouched: wealth management. Legacy Wall Street institutions still dominate private wealth, gatekeeping their services behind extremely high minimums, janky user experiences, and layers of fees. They are, in our opinion, the "final boss" of consumer fintech.

Our belief: every American deserves an elite wealth team navigating their capital, delivered at the cost and speed only humans working in harmony with AI can unlock.

At heart, we're a small pack of hard-working rebels operating at the intersection of engineering craft and high-stakes financial precision. Every person here is a calibrated bet on what we're building next. Our mission is to rebuild what a wealth management firm means, from the ground up, brick by brick, leveraging technology across the entire stack, so that AI lets one wealth advisor deliver what used to take a team, serving clients a Wall Street team never could have reached.

We're backed by a16z and Sam Altman, and currently power over $1 billion in assets under management.

Why Join Titan

For the right person, this will be one of the most rewarding roles they ever have.


Legacy-defining vision. Private wealth in every pocket isn't an incremental product. It’s not B2B automation. It’s a “before & after” moment in money.
The time is now. LLMs just unlocked what was impossible five years ago: truly personalized wealth management for everyone.
Outsized decision making. We're a small team by design. Every hire is precise, every role carries real weight, and your decisions disproportionately shape what we become.
Built in person, in the trenches. We're a high-touch, high-tempo group that works side by side. You’ll see our founders working in the trenches with the team everyday.
Ownership in every sense. Competitive cash and well-above-market equity. We believe in identifying only exceptional talent and compensating them generously.
World-class backing. Investors who share the bold vision: a16z, General Catalyst, Accel, Y Combinator, Sam Altman, Paul Graham, and more.


Role Overview

The Data Analyst role sits at the heart of how we make decisions, measure progress, and uncover opportunity. Your mission is to transform raw data into clarity, building the systems, tools, and insights that guide strategy across the business.

This isn’t just about dashboards or reports, it’s about architecting the flow of information that fuels every team, from Product to Finance. You’ll design and maintain the pipelines and models that power our analytics stack, ensuring our data is not only accurate and accessible, but deeply actionable.

You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering precision and business intuition: comfortable writing complex SQL one moment, then distilling findings into a clear narrative for leadership the next. You’ll push the organization toward a truly data-driven culture, one where insights are timely, trusted, and tied to real impact.

What You’ll Do


Design and maintain ETL workflows that move and transform data between multiple systems to power business intelligence dashboards.
Work extensively with Redshift to model and optimize data structures for reporting and analytics.
Translate and work with NoSQL data sources, ensuring smooth integration with other data platforms.
Build, automate, and monitor data pipelines using tools like Fivetran, Hightouch, Segment, and Stitch.
Collaborate with business teams — including Finance, Product, and Operations — to identify data needs and transform business questions into analytical solutions.
Support financial reporting and analytics by applying your understanding of accounting and finance-related concepts.
Create and maintain dashboards in tools such as Omni, Mode, and Mixpanel, ensuring teams have accurate and timely visibility into KPIs.
Partner with engineering to ensure data consistency, documentation, and governance across systems.
Advocate for and contribute to the development of a data-driven organizational culture.


Qualifications


Must come from a startup, fintech, or similarly fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Strong proficiency in SQL, with a deep understanding of data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning in Redshift.
Experience designing and maintaining ETL workflows that connect multiple data sources and ensure data integrity.
Comfortable working with NoSQL data and integrating it into analytics pipelines.
Familiarity with AWS ecosystem services and best practices for data storage, transformation, and access.
Scripting experience (e.g., Python, SQL scripts) and familiarity with version control (e.g., Git).
Skilled at working with cross-functional teams to identify business opportunities and deliver measurable impact.
Experience analyzing and visualizing finance and accounting data preferred.
Strong communication and data storytelling skills — able to make complex analyses clear and actionable.


Compensation Range: $125K - $180K

title: Data Engineer, Investment Data Platform
description:
The Firm

Castleton Tower is a boutique consulting firm founded by executives who have built and led quantitative research, data science, and technology teams at top-tier hedge funds and asset managers. We work exclusively with investment management firms, including asset allocators, asset managers, hedge funds, family offices, and RIAs, helping them modernize data infrastructure and build AI-ready foundations.

Our engagements combine senior strategy with hands-on implementation. We assess technical and business strategy, design the architecture, and build the data and AI infrastructure needed to support better investment decisions.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a data engineer to join a prominent asset allocator client as it builds a modern investment data platform. You will work on a small, high-standards team that is replacing a collection of disconnected applications and spreadsheets with a unified data foundation for investment, operations, and reporting.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone early in their career who wants to learn from experienced builders, take real ownership, and grow quickly. We care more about how you think, how carefully you work, and how much you want to own than about any specific tool.

What You Will Do


Build and maintain data pipelines and transformations in SQL and Python, using dbt, Snowflake, and orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow, or Azure Data Factory.
Model investment and operational data (positions, transactions, performance, reference data, and private-markets fund data) so it is accurate and easy to use.
Write tests, data quality checks, and reconciliations that prove the numbers are right, and fix the root cause when they aren't.
Ship through code review and CI/CD, and help keep production pipelines monitored and reliable.
Work with analysts and investment teams to understand what they need, and deliver datasets and reports (including Power BI) they can trust.
Use AI-assisted development tools to work faster while keeping quality high.


Qualifications

Required


3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related software role.
Strong SQL and Python, and solid grounding in data modeling and ETL/ELT.
Experience with a modern data warehouse (Snowflake, Synapse, Databricks, or similar) and a transformation or orchestration tool (dbt, ADF, Airflow, Dagster, or similar).
Habits of a careful engineer: version control, code review, testing, and monitoring.
Strong analytical ability and attention to detail.


Valued


Exposure to financial, investment, or private equity data.
Azure data services, Azure DevOps pipelines, or Power BI.
Experience reconciling data across systems.


Personal Attributes


High ownership: you take problems to resolution without being told.
Curious and quick to learn; you want to understand the investment side, not only the pipelines.
High standards for your own work, and open to direct feedback.
Energy and drive to grow into a senior engineer.


Location and Placement

Location: Hybrid, Northeast U.S.

This role is intended for full-time placement at a prominent asset allocator client. The successful candidate will work closely with the client's engineering leadership and investment, operations, and technology stakeholders, and spend regular time in the office.

Compensation: Competitive total compensation commensurate with experience.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Qualitate

Qualitate is building the AI-native continuous intelligence platform for enterprises, investment firms, and asset managers. We automate the entire primary research workflow, from study design and expert recruitment through AI-moderated interviews and insight synthesis, replacing weeks of manual research with high output signal in hours.

Primary research remains slow and transactional for everyone involved. Investment and corporate strategy teams spend hundreds of hours coordinating intermediaries, scheduling calls, and synthesizing fragmented insights. Experts face repetitive outreach, screener calls, schedule wrangling, and one-off engagements that offer them little control or lasting value.

Qualitate transforms this experience with an AI-native expert network platform that gives participants the flexibility to contribute on their own time while enabling research at unprecedented scale. Qualitate’s AI Moderator conducts thousands of conversations with experts each month, capturing forward-looking purchasing plans, competitive displacement, and real-time ROI signals. Our continuous intelligence platform then turns these conversations into quantified, time-series outputs tracking over 10,000 public and private companies, queryable instantly in natural language. Our customers include some of the world's largest enterprises, hedge funds, PE firms, credit investors, and venture capital firms.

The Role

Qualitate is building the primary research layer for investors and corporate strategy teams. Our AI interviews experts, turns those conversations into structured intelligence, and delivers it to the funds and companies acting on it. Next, we're turning that into an always-on intelligence platform. Customers will bring their own proprietary data alongside ours, and AI agents will run research workflows end to end.

All of that runs on data, and as our first dedicated Data Engineer, you'll own it. You'll build the pipelines that feed our AI moderator, the models that turn thousands of expert conversations into structured, searchable insights, and the systems that will let customers plug their own data into Qualitate. You'll work closely with Applied AI, Market Research, and Engineering, but the architecture decisions are yours. Our clients make investment decisions on this data, so accuracy isn't a feature. It's the product. You'll set that bar and shape how data works at Qualitate for years to come.

What You’ll Own


Build and maintain data pipelines. Design ETL/ELT processes that ingest unstructured data, quantitative metrics, 3rd party datasets into our core systems.
Design data models and data systems. Build and evolve data models across relational and non-relational systems. You'll work with structured application data in relational databases alongside unstructured data stored in S3 and indexed in semantic search engines.
Build AI-powered data enrichment pipelines. Use LLMs and other AI systems to extract structured information from unstructured data, classify and enrich records, and integrate AI-generated outputs into reliable production data workflows and evaluation systems.
Own data quality end-to-end. Build automated QA checks, monitoring, and alerting to catch anomalies before they become client-facing problems.
Partner cross-functionally. Work directly with Research, Applied AI, and Engineering to define schemas, data contracts, and reporting needs as new features are shipped.
Document as you build. Maintain clear data lineage, schema documentation, and runbooks — you're building the systems, so you're setting the data foundation of the company.


Who This Role Is For


You're strong in SQL. You can write complex, performant queries against relational datasets and understand how to reason about data at scale.
You're a capable software engineer. You have experience with either TypeScript or Python and can write production-quality code for automation, data pipelines, integrations, and internal tooling.
You can build robust data integrations. You can work with APIs, databases, files, and other external data sources and build reliable ingestion processes around authentication, pagination, rate limits, incremental extraction, retries, schema changes, and error handling.
Research and integrate third-party datasets. Research and evaluate company identifiers, entity-matching strategies, corporate hierarchies, subsidiaries, acquisitions, and build reliable processes to map and reconcile these entities across different data sources.
You can work across different types of data. You're comfortable with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data and understand the tradeoffs between relational databases, object storage, search/indexing systems, and analytical data stores.
You'll work with our current stack and help shape what comes next. You will help maintain our TypeScript pipelines running on scheduled jobs and Postgres-native queues, S3 for object storage, and AWS Bedrock for retrieval. Experience with a modern warehouse and transformation stack (e.g. Snowflake/BigQuery, dbt, Airflow) is a plus.
You're comfortable with ambiguity. Early-stage data infrastructure is messy — you're energized by building order out of that, not frustrated by it.


What Sets You Apart


Prior experience in data engineering for a technology startup, ideally in fintech
You've been early on the engineering team at a company and helped build the function from scratch — not just used tools others built.
Exposure to LLM-driven data pipelines (labeling, moderation, quality scoring) is a strong plus.
You've worked in market research, expert networks, or financial services and understand the data integrity bar those industries demand.


Compensation & Benefits


Base salary: $170-200K depending on experience.
Bonus: Eligible for cash bonus tied to individual and company performance
Equity: Meaningful early-stage grant with upside tied to company growth.
Benefits: Health coverage, flexible PTO, paid holidays.
Location: Full-time, in-person in New York City.

Excellence. You'll be held accountable to an exceptionally high bar for quality and impact.
High velocity. Fast-paced work environment in terms of growth, decision making, and time to impact.
High agency. Ownership over how you work, not just what you work on. We hire people we trust to figure it out.
Shared ambition. A small, early team disrupting the multi-billion dollar market research industry with AI.
Joy. We work hard and genuinely enjoy working with each other. Dedication to our work is matched only by our passion for fostering an enjoyable, collaborative work environment.

title: Manager, DTC Analytics
description:
About Mammoth Brands

Mammoth Brands (formerly Harry’s Inc.) is the modern CPG company behind brands Harry’s, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. We’re building a new model—and home—brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples’ lives, and ultimately challenge the status quo. Our mission is to “Create Things People Like More.” Simply put: everything we do should be better than what already exists. If it’s not, we don’t do it. This guides everything we do, from developing the best product experiences, to making Mammoth Brands a great place to work, to exploring innovative ways to give back to our community.

We got our start in 2013 when our co-founders created Harry's. They built the brand differently—online first, prioritizing direct relationships with customers—and in the process learned they’d created something bigger: a playbook and platform that could help other brands grow and scale to their full potential, and a vision to reimagine consumer packaged goods. Today, Mammoth Brands is a growing portfolio of brands and the largest CPG company built in the last 20 years. Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: to create a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community. As a company, we’re also committed to making a positive impact and have donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date.

We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day-to-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it.

About The Team

The Centralized Insights & Analytics (CIA) team is a critical function that drives proactive insights-to-action within the US Personal Care organization. The CIA organization unites capabilities across data science, analytics, insights, and category management into an integrated function to translate insights into action for everyday decisions and more complex business questions, helping shape the future of our business strategy and enabling us to best serve our customers. Capabilities built by this team will meaningfully impact the business through marketing optimization, channel strategy, site optimization, selling stories, thought leadership, innovation, and overall consumer/shopper experience.

About The Role

As the Analytics Manager for DTC, you'll build and drive the reporting and diagnostic analytics that advance our strategy - and turn that analysis into a point of view. You'll design and report on DTC KPIs and analyses spanning the user journey from acquisition through conversion, post-purchase engagement and retention, subscriptions, distribution, and site experimentation. When a stakeholder brings you a question, they should walk away with a recommendation, not just a chart or data point - that means connecting the dots across data sources, business priorities, and customer signal, and knowing which questions are worth chasing and which aren't. We need someone with strong business acumen, excellent storytelling skills, a passion for consumer empathy, a robust technical toolkit, and the confidence to share a strong point of view, even with people more senior than you. You'll work with key decision-makers throughout the DTC organization, and share your insights and recommendations - and defend them - with all levels of the business.

Here's What You'll Accomplish


Synthesizing data on a regular basis to provide the DTC team with brand-level insights on business health - and a clear recommendation on what to do about it, not just the numbers
Leverage our BI tool Omni to build, maintain, and own dashboards that empower the business to interpret and act quickly. (e.g., track inventory issues across retailers and build actionable alerting.)
Become an expert on existing DTC reporting and drive towards improvement
Plan, design, and implement reports that highlight key performance indicators
Enhance our A/B testing reporting suite
Track new feature launches by Product & Engagement teams and build/manage the reporting for how they perform
Work closely with the teams in our DTC Org to drive value for the business
Gain a strong understanding of their data problems and use our Analytics toolkit to find a solution (What data do we need, how can we get it, and how can we automate reporting?)
Driving deep analysis of the whats and whys of key drivers to surface hypotheses for action
Be a strong, trusted voice and thought leader for the brands you support - bringing a well-reasoned point of view to the table, and comfortable sharing it with stakeholders at all levels
Enable your stakeholders and leaders to get sharper and smarter on the data, the business, and how we tackle our biggest questions just by working alongside you
Bring a strong, well-reasoned point of view and advocate for the brands you support, comfortable doing so with people more senior than you
Your impact and influence comes from how much smarter you make the people around you and your strong perspective
Help define how we measure and report out on performance on ecommerce across key KPIs, set up dashboarding capability, and regularly track and share the overall performance of the business to drive strategic planning
Identify analytics pain points and inefficiencies, and develop new tools and automated processes to optimize and streamline. AI is integral to the work, not an afterthought.
Be a data-evangelist and sparring partner across the organization, sharing best practices and insights and willing to challenge the status quo with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at every level

This May Describe You


5+ years in data analytics or a similarly analytical field, using data to drive decision-making and narrative development in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment, with a strong understanding of the role analytics plays in a cross-disciplinary digital product development lifecycle.
Proficient Technical Skill – Fluent in SQL (Python or R a plus), with the ability to query, manipulate, and analyze data end-to-end to accelerate the business.
BI Tool Fluency – Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards and models in a modern BI platform. We currently run in Omni; prior experience with Looker, Tableau, or Power BI will be an enabler.
AI-Forward – You use AI tools to speed up your own analysis, and you're comfortable helping others on the team build that same fluency.
Business Acumen & Judgment – You connect the dots across data sources, business priorities, and customer signal, and you have a nose for which questions are worth chasing - so you spend your time on the highest-impact problems, not just the interesting ones.
Engaged Thought Partner – When someone brings you a question, they leave with a recommendation and a point of view, not just an analysis plan. You can point to specific insights that changed a real decision, not just reports you've shipped.
Clear, Confident Communicator – You explain complex ideas simply, and you're as comfortable challenging a room full of senior stakeholders as you are presenting to them.
You thrive on direct, honest, and supportive communication and feedback
You are infectiously optimistic and curious - To you, there’s nothing more exciting than a new challenge. Hard things are hard, but you don’t let that get in the way


Who You Will Work With


You will report to the Sr. Director of Omnichannel Analytics, with a dotted line to our VP of DTC
Within the broader CIA org, you'll work most closely with the other data analysts and analytics engineers on the team.
Within the larger Digital org, you’ll work closely with our DTC team (Product/Engagement/CX) as well as Distribution and Finance.


Benefits And Perks


Medical, dental, and vision coverage
401k match
Equity in Mammoth Brands
Flexible time off and working hours
L&D stipend
4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years, 6 weeks after 10 years, and 8 weeks after 15 years
20 fully paid weeks off for parents who give birth, or 16 fully paid weeks off for all other paths to parenthood
Fun IRL and virtual events including happy hours, team building events, and parties on our rooftop
Free products from our family of brands


The Mammoth Brands' working model is in-office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Our beautiful 70,000 square foot SoHo office is decked out with bagels on Wednesdays and lunch on Thursdays, and fully stocked kitchens with snacks, coffee, and drinks everyday. Can’t forget the free products and the opportunity to have some meetings without Zoom!

We can’t quantify all of the intangible things we think you’ll love about working at Mammoth Brands, like the exciting challenges we tackle, the smart and humble team you’ll get to work with, and our supportive and inclusive culture. That said, our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of our total rewards package, which also includes a comprehensive set of benefits and our equity program. The base salary hiring range for this position is $132,000-$150,000, but the final compensation offer will ultimately be based on the candidate’s location, skill level and experience.

Mammoth Brands' commitment to providing equal employment opportunities extends to all aspects of employment, including job assignment, compensation, discipline and access to benefits and training.

We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated to going above and beyond in fostering diversity across our company.

If visa sponsorship is required for work authorization, please note that Mammoth Brands in collaboration with immigration counsel will manage and submit all necessary legal filings on behalf of the candidate.

It is important to us that every candidate has a positive and safe experience with Mammoth Brands. Please be aware of the possibility of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, and employment offers that are designed to collect personal information or charge fees for recruitment or training services.

Mammoth Brands will never charge any application, processing, or training fee at any point in our hiring process. Every genuine opportunity we have will be listed on our careers page. If something ever feels off, trust your instincts and don't hesitate to reach out to us directly to verify.

title: Medical Management Data Analyst
description:
Empower. Unite. Care.

MetroPlusHealth is committed to empowering New Yorkers by uniting communities through care. We believe that

Health care is a right, not a privilege. If you have compassion and a collaborative spirit, work with us. You can come

to work being proud of what you do every day.

About NYC Health + Hospitals

MetroPlusHealth provides the highest quality healthcare services to residents of Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens and Staten Island through a comprehensive list of products, including, but not limited to, New York State Medicaid Managed Care, Medicare, Child Health Plus, Exchange, Partnership in Care, MetroPlus Gold, Essential Plan, etc. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of NYC Health + Hospitals, the largest public health system in the United States, MetroPlusHealth network includes over 27,000 primary care providers, specialists and participating clinics. For more than 30 years, MetroPlusHealth has been committed to building strong relationships with its members and providers.

Position Overview

The Medical Management Data Analyst supports Medical Management Analytics with a primary focus on monthly HEDIS builds and annual quality reporting submissions (HEDIS, QARR, PCMH) to NYS DOH and CMS, helping ensure data is accurate, complete, and delivered on time. In support of monthly HEDIS builds, the Analyst monitors and prepares key data inputs, including claims, provider, member, encounter, and supplemental data, ensuring these feeds are complete and properly delivered to downstream systems and vendor processes. The Analyst performs routine validation of build outputs, including measure-level quality checks, investigation of variances, and confirmation that results align with expected specifications and prior

performance. This role also supports quality improvement efforts by handling routine and ad hoc data requests, including measure-specific analyses, and contributing to the development and maintenance of dashboards and reports used to track performance. The Analyst position requires comfort working with both structured and unstructured data and contributing to the setup and refinement of new data sources and pipelines that enhance quality reporting and analytics capabilities.

Work Shifts

9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Duties & Responsibilities


Support monthly HEDIS builds and annual HEDIS, QARR, and PCMH submissions, helping ensure timely, accurate, and complete data for rate production and regulatory reporting.
Monitor and prepare key data inputs for monthly builds, including claims, provider, member, encounter, and supplemental data, ensuring completeness and proper delivery to vendor systems.
Assist with intake, tracking, and ongoing support of data feeds from providers, vendors, and health information exchanges (HIEs/RHIO), contributing to stable and reliable data pipelines.
Perform routine validation checks on HEDIS build outputs and quality measure results, including review of variances, identification of discrepancies, and confirmation against expected benchmarks.
Investigate and resolve data quality issues in collaboration with senior analysts and upstream data partners to support accurate reporting.
Execute standard queries and data extracts to support monthly production processes, audits, and submission readiness activities.
Handle routine and ad hoc data requests in support of quality improvement initiatives, including measure level data pulls, gap analysis, and performance tracking.
Contribute to the development, maintenance, and refinement of dashboards and reports used to monitor quality performance and pay for performance programs.
Work with structured and unstructured data to support evolving data needs, including assisting with onboarding and validation of new data sources and pipelines.
Support documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement of data workflows, ensuring consistency, transparency, and alignment with department analytics processes.



Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in information systems, data analytics, or a related field required. Master’s preferred.
3 years of experience extracting, manipulating, and analyzing data in a healthcare, public health, or analytics environment.
3 years of experience using analytics and BI tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, R, Python, Power BI, Tableau) to support data analysis and reporting.
Ability to interpret and apply technical reporting specifications and measure logic using analytics tools to produce and validate quality reporting outputs.
Demonstrated understanding of data quality concepts, with ability to execute data preparation, validation, and reconciliation processes with strong diagnostic rigor, including identifying data anomalies and discrepancies, applying validation rules, and ensuring accuracy of reporting outputs.
Ability to collaborate with IT, data vendors, and internal stakeholders, with an understanding of data architecture, data flow, and dependencies across systems supporting quality reporting.



Professional Competencies


Integrity & Trust
Customer Focus
Functional/Technical Skills
Strong written and verbal presentation as well as data analysis skills required.
Ability to work independently and multitask to meet deadlines.
Position requires individual with high degree of accuracy. Must be able to translate theoretical knowledge into practical application.
Displays strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership ability across all levels coupled with effective problem solving, conceptual thinking, quantitative and analytical skills.

title: Curacity - Sr. Analytics and Data Quality Analyst
description:
Are you ready to join Connecticut Innovation’s vibrant community of innovators? Connecticut Innovations (“CI”) is Connecticut’s strategic venture capital arm, and we are passionate about serving our portfolio of 220+ companies across various industries, with strengths in life sciences, technology, and climate tech.




Come join CI Portfolio Company, Curacity: Hotel marketing software that turns media into revenue!!




Location: New York City (Hybrid)




About Curacity




Curacity is a two-sided marketplace connecting travel brands that need to be discovered with the publishers, travel writers, and content creators travelers actually trust. Hotels and cruise brands define the editorial coverage they need; our network of publishers and creators produces original content; Curacity coordinates the fulfillment and measures the outcomes.




We operate two products on that network. Newsletter places original editorial recommendations in front of publisher subscriber audiences and ties the resulting bookings back to the content that drove them. Vista AI builds the distributed editorial footprint that determines whether a property gets recommended when a traveler asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Mode, or Gemini where to stay.




Curacity partners with publications including AFAR and Travel + Leisure, and was named among Inc. 5000's Top 20 Travel & Hospitality Companies and Digiday's Best Content Marketing Platform of 2024. We are headquartered in New York with an office in Stamford, CT.




Role Overview




Our reporting, attribution, and billing depend on data we receive from hotel partners and integration sources. When that data is incomplete, incorrectly mapped, or misunderstood, the impact can reach both our customers and our business.




We’re hiring a Senior Analytics & Data Quality Analyst to help us strengthen the reliability of that data and turn it into useful business insight.




This role will evolve over time. Initially, you will focus heavily on validating data during a major transition: investigating discrepancies, confirming that partner and property data has been migrated and mapped correctly, improving data hygiene, and helping establish repeatable quality controls. As that transition is completed and those processes mature, the role will broaden into general analytics, including developing dashboards, analyzing business performance, defining metrics, and producing actionable insights for teams across the company.




This is a strong fit for someone who combines analytical rigor with curiosity and practical judgment. You enjoy tracing an unexpected number back to its source, but you are equally interested in explaining what the data means and helping people make better decisions with it.




What You'll Do




Initially: validate and strengthen our data

Validate data associated with integrations, hotel onboarding, and our broader data transition.
Use SQL and other analytical tools to assess completeness, accuracy, consistency, expected ranges, referential integrity, and mapping to our internal data model.
Reconcile data across source systems, transformed datasets, reports, and billing outputs.
Investigate suspicious values, missing records, duplicate entities, attribution issues, and other inconsistencies.
Trace issues through ingestion, transformation, and reporting workflows to identify likely root causes.
Distinguish among internal defects, upstream source-data problems, mapping issues, and expected business behavior.
Document findings clearly and work with engineering, product, operations, and account teams to coordinate resolution.
Improve data-hygiene practices by identifying recurring issues and recommending validation rules, monitoring, automation, or process changes.
Help establish a repeatable approach to validating new data sources and newly onboarded properties.




Over time: expand into broader analytics

Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting for business and operational teams.
Analyze trends, performance drivers, and anomalies, translating findings into clear recommendations.
Partner with stakeholders to turn business questions into well-defined analyses and metrics.
Define and document important fields, KPIs, calculations, and business rules.
Improve the usability and trustworthiness of our reporting and analytics datasets.
Perform ad hoc analysis to support decisions across the company.
Continue monitoring high-risk data areas and improving quality controls as our data and products evolve.




Qualifications




Experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data quality, analytics engineering, or a related role.
Strong SQL skills, including the ability to investigate unfamiliar datasets, reconcile results across sources, and diagnose unexpected output.
Experience working with data pipelines and an understanding of how data moves through ingestion, transformation, warehousing, and reporting.
Experience validating data from external sources such as APIs, file feeds, partner platforms, or third-party integrations.
Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail. You test assumptions, look for edge cases, and do not treat a successful load as proof that the data is correct.
Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through a modern BI or visualization tool.
The ability to explain data issues and analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational and written communication skills, including the ability to document findings and requirements precisely.
Comfort working independently in an environment where some processes and definitions are still being established.
The ability to balance immediate investigation with longer-term improvements that reduce recurring work.







Nice to Have




Experience with Python or another scripting language for analysis, validation, or lightweight automation.
Experience with dbt tests, Great Expectations, Soda, Monte Carlo, or other data-quality and observability tools.
Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or a comparable platform.
Experience working with data that affects billing, revenue, attribution, or other financially sensitive workflows.
Familiarity with entity resolution, identity matching, or record-linkage problems.
Experience with hospitality, travel, marketing analytics, or advertising technology data.
Familiarity with orchestration tools and modern cloud data warehouses.
Experience improving data-quality or analytics practices in a growing organization.




What Success Looks Like




In your first 90 days: You understand our most important data sources, business definitions, and reporting workflows. You have helped validate high-priority data associated with our transition, established a consistent way to document and investigate discrepancies, and become a trusted partner for data questions.

During the transition: High-risk data is systematically reviewed, material discrepancies are identified and resolved, and recurring problems are converted into clearer rules, better monitoring, or more reliable processes. Stakeholders have visibility into validation progress and outstanding risks.

As the role evolves: You spend less time performing repetitive manual validation and more time helping teams understand and use the data. Core dashboards and metrics are reliable and well documented, business questions are answered with clear analysis, and data issues are increasingly detected before they affect customers or financial workflows.




Why This Role Is Interesting

title: Data Analyst III, Reporting & Analytics
description:
What you'll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we're the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare "win win" — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

About the role:

We are seeking an exceptional AI-Native Data Analyst III to join our Reporting team. Our team delivers insightful, high-quality analysis to our clients on their healthcare use and their engagement with the Garner product. The team supports a combination of automated reports that we create at higher volume, and innovative custom analysis to provide insights for specific client situations.

Supporting this responsibility, this role must deeply understand and improve upon the full suite of our existing automated reports, consistently identifying and implementing ways to improve their efficiency, accuracy, and client-impact.

This role will be based in our New York City office (in the Financial District). You must be willing to work in the office 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

Own client-facing analysis end-to-end. Build, maintain, and produce key reports for clients across our data ecosystem, from scoping to delivery.
Be a thought partner to our client-facing teams. Use a deep understanding of our clients and the Garner product to partner with stakeholders, answering questions via analytically robust reports and presentations.
Build scalable report automation. Collaborate with the data engineering team to create maintainable automation to create an ever-evolving suite of client reporting.
Develop deep domain expertise. Build a strong understanding of your analytical domain so you can independently drive meaningful insights.
Close reporting gaps. Identify gaps between the needs of our clients and our reports, proactively develop new insights to fill them.
Raise the bar on data practices. Advocate for best practices in visualization, documentation, metric consistency, and stakeholder communication across teams.
Answer high-stakes, ambiguous questions. Run deep-dive investigations into complex business problems — the kind of analysis leadership uses to make strategic calls.

You'll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You'll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

title: Senior Performance Marketing Analyst
description:

This role will establish the analytical foundation used to evaluate marketing effectiveness, optimize investment, and understand the incremental impact of paid media on customer acquisition and long-term business growth.

Partner with Data Engineering and BI teams to ensure seamless data ingestion, including integrations such as Adverity into BigQuery, streamline onboarding of new channels and data sources, and continuously improve reporting infrastructure, data quality, and reliability.

Design, execute, document, and interpret incrementality tests, lift studies, A/B experiments, and custom experimentation frameworks across paid media channels.

Translate measurement results into clear recommendations on channel effectiveness, marginal investment, scaling opportunities, and areas of diminishing return.

Develop analytical frameworks to evaluate customer acquisition beyond first-order economics, including cohort quality, repeat behavior, retention, contribution margin, and LTV by acquisition source.
Partner with CRM, Loyalty, and broader Marketing Analytics teams to connect customer acquisition, retention, and customer lifetime value.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for Marketing leadership and cross-functional partners.
Help establish a holistic view of customer growth by connecting media investment decisions to downstream customer value and long-term business performance.




Qualifications:

3–5+ years of experience in performance marketing analytics, digital media analytics, marketing science, or a closely related field.
Demonstrated experience translating analytical insights into media optimization and investment recommendations.
Experience partnering cross-functionally with Marketing, Finance, BI, Data Engineering, or related teams.
Advanced experience with Google Analytics 4 and ad platform analytics, including Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads.
Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to independently query, join, transform, and analyze large-scale customer, transaction, and marketing datasets.

Advanced Excel skills and strong quantitative problem-solving capabilities.
Strong expertise in designing and analyzing incrementality tests, lift studies, and A/B experiments.
Proven experience interpreting Marketing Mix Models and understanding their role within a broader measurement framework.
Strong understanding of attribution methodologies and the limitations of platform-reported and multi-touch attribution.
Ability to integrate multiple measurement methodologies to develop a balanced, evidence-based view of marketing effectiveness.
Experience working within e-commerce, retail, subscription, or digitally led consumer business models.
Experience analyzing customer acquisition economics, cohort performance, retention, or lifetime value.
Degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, Business, or another quantitative field.
Ability and willingness to work on-site at our office in Tribeca 3 days per week.
